title: Dependency onboarding lanes and fail-safe cadence for cross-team roadmap deliveries
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight operational pattern for ingesting, triaging, and committing to roadmap-level dependencies across Engineering, Design, Security, and Infra. The goal is to establish 'onboarding lanes' that classify incoming dependency requests (Blocked, Requires Alignment, FYI) with clear SLAs for responses, an automated cadence for readiness checks, and an agreed fail-safe (fallback) plan per initiative. This ticket delivers the playbook, dashboard wiring, and a pilot with two active initiatives to validate run rates and choke points.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published in Confluence with lane definitions, SLAs, and ownership matrix
Dependency intake form (Coveted fields: impact, required-by date, customers affected, security needs) live and linked in PM onboarding checklist
Readiness dashboard widget (per-initiative dependency heat score) visible in Console for PM/Eng leads
Two initiatives complete pilot: one infra-heavy (Dedicated) and one API feature (Hosted) — each with documented fallback plans
Automated weekly digest created that surfaces P0/P1 unresolved dependencies to execs and triage channel
tasks: Draft lane definitions and SLAs (PM lead)
Design lightweight intake UI and sample microcopy (Design)
Add minimal telemetry hooks to Console for dependency state (Eng)
Define fail-safe patterns and rollback criteria with Security and Infra
Pilot run with Initiative A (Dedicated capacity controls) and Initiative B (API feature)
comments: 2026-02-18: Kickoff meeting — aligned on three lanes and 72-hour SLA for acknowledgement. Action: PM to author playbook draft.
2026-02-24: Design reviewed intake wireframe; recommended inline examples for 'required-by date' to avoid vague dates.
2026-03-01: Eng raised concern about adding telemetry weight to Console; agreed to a lightweight counter and a per-initiative tag to start.
2026-03-04: Security requested that any dependency marked 'high' include a threat-model snapshot. Added to intake required fields.
2026-03-06: Decided to pilot for 6 weeks and measure MTTR to resolution and percentage of dependencies with fallback plans. Miguel will schedule pilot onboarding sessions.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams treat lane assignment as advisory, not binding -> Mitigation: Add ownership and a weekly escalation email for unresolved P0/P1
Risk: Intake form becomes too heavyweight -> Mitigation: Mandatory minimal fields only; optional attachments for deeper analysis
Risk: Metrics noise from duplicate dependencies -> Mitigation: Dedup heuristics (title + initiative tag) and manual triage for ambiguous cases
pilot_plan: Select two initiatives (one infra, one product) and onboard via a 45-minute workshop. Track SLA adherence (acknowledge within 72h), resolution time, and presence of a documented fallback. After 6 weeks, run a retrospective and decide on company-wide rollout or iterate on lanes.
notes_for_followup: Add integration for Slack triage channel -> incoming P0/P1 auto-posts
Explore tying dependency state to release gating in the Console (opt-in)
After pilot, propose a lightweight policy to require fallback plans for any dependency with customer_impact >= medium
